title: Sereja and Straight Lines
statementMd:
Sereja placed $*n*$ points on a plane. Now Sereja wants to place on the plane two straight lines, intersecting at a right angle, so that one of the straight lines intersect the $*Ox*$ axis at an angle of $45$ degrees and the maximum distance from the points to the straight lines were minimum.

In this problem we consider the distance between points $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ and $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ equal $|*x*_{1} - *x*_{2}| + |*y*_{1} - *y*_{2}|$. The distance between the point and the straight lines is the minimum distance from the point to some point belonging to one of the lines.

Help Sereja, find the maximum distance from the points to the optimally located straight lines.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$. Next $*n*$ lines contain the coordinates of the lines. The $*i*$-th line contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ $(|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9})$.

## Output

In a single line print a real number — the answer to the problem. Your answer will be considered correct iff its absolute or relative error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
statementZhMd:
Sereja 在平面上放置了 $*n*$ 个点。现在，Sereja 想在平面上放置两条相互垂直的直线，使其中一条直线与 $*Ox*$ 轴成 $45$ 度角，并且使所有点到这两条直线的最大距离尽可能小。

在本题中，我们认为点 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ 与 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ 之间的距离等于 $|*x*_{1} - *x*_{2}| + |*y*_{1} - *y*_{2}|$。点到这两条直线的距离，是该点到其中某条直线上某个点的最小距离。

请帮助 Sereja 求出在最优放置的直线下，所有点到这两条直线的最大距离。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$。接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含点的坐标。第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ $(|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{9})$。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个实数，即题目的答案。当答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$ 时，您的答案将被视为正确。
